summary: BRC Group Holdings (formerly B. Riley Financial) filed an 8-K reporting that on November 3, 2026 its subsidiaries BRF Finance Co., LLC and BR Financial Holdings, LLC closed the sale of Seller's remaining membership interests in Great American Holdings, LLC to purchaser entities affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, L.P., which has co-owned Great American since 2024. Seller received total cash consideration of $62,250,000, roughly $51.7 million of which was applied toward repayment of debt; a related direct financial obligation was also disclosed. No board recommendation or advisor is named for this negotiated equity sale. Watch residual deleveraging and any remaining Oaktree ties.
